title: GF180MCU open PDK (prerun process, not the tapeout target)
source: https://gf180mcu-pdk.readthedocs.io; empirical values marked as such

prerunConstraint.note: Owner decision 2026-10-18: the GF180 prerun uses a 1.2 x 2 mm die (2.4 mm2). With the 350 um gf180mcu_fd_io pads a 1 x 2 mm die leaves too little core for the engine; compressing to 2 mm2 is a follow-up for the target process.

ioRingWidthMm.source: gf180mcu_fd_io LEF: pads 75x350 um, corners 355x355 um, placed 26 um from the die edge (LibreLane PAD_EDGE_SPACING of the PDK); the only IO library of gf180mcuD

flopBitAreaUm2.source: gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__dffq_1 area 63.66 um2 (Liberty tt_025C); typ/high add enable and read multiplexing

powerOverhead.source: power grid share of core area

technology.source: gf180mcuD in the pinned iic-osic-tools image

spatialCells.source: Yosys synthesis (synth -booth, abc to gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0 tt_025C_5v00) of the taalas-spatial/1 design of the proxy model (dim 16, hidden 32, 2 layers, context 64, ternary weights), 2026-10-21; cell area before placement
spatialCells.confidence: measured (synthesis of one design; placement not yet confirmed)

serialAdderUm2.source: sp_sadd: full adder and carry flop with the run's clear; 162.44 (add), 169.03 (subtract)

delayBitUm2.source: sp_taps: one flop with clear per delay bit (lines of 9, 13, 14, 15 bits: 86.2 to 86.6 per bit)

outputStageBaseUm2.source: sp_out without its W result bits: rounding (sticky, half, carry), overflow flag; from W = 16 (2342.28) and W = 32 (4168.68)

outputStageBitUm2.source: sp_out per result bit: flop with shift and saturation load

kvBitUm2.confidence: measured (typ, low); high is an assumed allowance
kvBitUm2.source: KV register file bit: gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__dffq_1 (63.66) plus its share of the row write enable and the 64:1 read multiplexer (42.4): the proxy's core logic grew from 0.837 to 2.225 mm2 for 32,768 bits when the rotating rings became a register file (synthesis 2026-10-21; the rings needed a hold buffer per bit and did not place); high 115 is an assumed allowance, not measured

tableBitUm2.confidence: measured (typ); low and high are assumed allowances
tableBitUm2.source: constant tables as logic (case statements): 64,545 um2 for 43,456 table bits of the proxy; depends on the contents; low 1.2 and high 2.0 are assumed allowances for other contents, not measured

coreFlopBitUm2.confidence: measured (typ, low); high is an assumed allowance
coreFlopBitUm2.source: core registers beyond the KV rings: dffq_1; their reset and enable logic is counted in the core logic; high 75 is an assumed allowance for enable or reset cells, not measured

coreLogicUm2PerDim.confidence: measured at dim 16 (typ, low); other dimensions extrapolated; high is an assumed allowance
coreLogicUm2PerDim.source: core logic of the proxy without its dividers (sequencing, rmsnorm, RoPE, SiLU, the elementwise multipliers, index units, selection): 0.972 mm2 at dim 16, synthesized 2026-10-21; other dimensions extrapolated linearly; it holds about seven multipliers whose count does not grow with the dimension; high (+30%) is an assumed allowance, not measured

hostUm2.confidence: measured (typ, low); high is an assumed allowance
hostUm2.source: sp_host (SPI slave with READ) 18,422 and chip top 127; high 20,000 is an assumed allowance, not measured

dividerLogicUm2.confidence: measured (least-squares over 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 dividers); high is an assumed allowance
dividerLogicUm2.source: logic of one softmax divider (23-bit compare and subtract, its probability selection): total cells of the proxy design with 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 dividers (5.874, 5.902, 5.936, 6.028, 6.227 mm2), less the divider's registers (39 bits, counted as core registers)
